title: Nasty Juice Cush Man 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: A legendary e-liquid from Nasty Juice, Cushman is a mango-based e-liquid that’s truly alive with flavour. The ripe, sunny mango explodes on your tastebuds before gently falling away beneath a soft and refreshing layer of cool mint. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
